claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Sorrento, on Piazza Tasso, with views over the Bay of Naples and Mount Vesuvius.

findings.quote: Grand Hotel Excelsior Vittoria is in the heart of Sorrento, on Piazza Tasso, with panoramic views over the Bay of Naples and Mount Vesuvius.

claims.text: The hotel has been family-owned since 1834.

findings.quote: Family-owned since 1834

claims.text: Fifth-generation members of the Fiorentino family now run the hotel.

findings.quote: Today, fifth-generation Fiorentinos are the custodians

claims.text: Rooms are classic in style, with antique furniture and a Sorrentine palette of blues and whites.

findings.quote: Classic, with antique furniture set against a Sorrentine paint palette of blues and whites.

claims.text: Many rooms and suites have views over the Bay of Naples, and some have private terraces or balconies.

findings.quote: The hotel offers elegant rooms and suites, many with views over the Bay of Naples, private terraces or balconies

claims.text: Terrazza Bosquet serves refined Mediterranean cuisine with panoramic views over the Bay of Naples.

findings.quote: Terrazza Bosquet offers Michelin-starred dining with refined Mediterranean cuisine and panoramic views over the Bay of Naples.

claims.text: Terrazza Vittoria serves Campanian produce at lunch, with simple plates such as spaghetti in San Marzano tomato sauce or lentil soup.

findings.quote: Laid-back suppers at Terrazza Vittoria make a song and dance of Campanian produce at lunch, with on-point yet simple plates such as spaghetti in a San Marzano tomato sauce or lentil soup.

claims.text: Breakfast is served under frescoes at Ristorante Vittoria, with homemade cakes and marmalades.

findings.quote: breakfast under the frescoes at Ristorante Vittoria is a heady procession of homemade cakes and marmalades

claims.text: The spa has private spa suites with jacuzzi and outdoor areas.

findings.quote: Private Spa Suites
Dedicated spaces with jacuzzi and outdoor areas for an intimate, highly private wellness experience.

claims.text: Spa facials and massages use products from the Swiss brand Valmont.

findings.quote: Facials and massages use products from Swiss beauty brand Valmont.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler named the hotel to its Gold List 2026.

findings.quote: Gold List 2026

claims.text: Boutique Spa La Serra is set in the private gardens, inside a restored 19th-century greenhouse.

findings.quote: A secluded wellness retreat in the private gardens, set within a restored 19th-century greenhouse.
Boutique Spa La Serra

claims.text: According to legend, the Roman emperor Augustus once built his villa on the hotel's site.

findings.quote: This is the site where, according to legend, Augustus, founder of the Roman Empire, once built his villa

claims.text: The hotel spans three buildings: La Vittoria, opened by the Fiorentino family in 1834, La Rivale from 1882, and the Swiss-style La Favorita from the early 20th century.

findings.quote: the Fiorentino family built the first of three buildings to accommodate well-to-do travellers, opening La Vittoria in 1834
A second building, La Rivale, followed in 1882, and the third—the curiously Swiss-style La Favorita—was built in the early 20th century

claims.text: A private lift gives access toward the port area, convenient for boat days to Capri and along the coast.

findings.quote: The hotel offers private lift access toward the port area, making boat days to Capri and coastal itineraries particularly convenient.

claims.text: The hotel's suites include the Pavarotti Suite, the Caruso Suite and the Margaret Suite, named for famous guests.

findings.quote: read like a roll-call of the hotel’s famous guests (the Pavarotti Suite, the Caruso Suite, the Margaret Suite)

claims.text: The hotel sits on a cliff above the sea in the town centre; guests reach the port area and seafront by a private lift.

findings.quote: On a cliff above the Bay of Naples and Mount Vesuvius
is in the heart of Sorrento, on Piazza Tasso
The hotel offers private lift access toward the port area
a lift which deposits guests 164 feet down to the seafront

claims.text: Rooms are classic, with antique furniture, rather than contemporary in style.

findings.quote: Classic, with antique furniture set against a Sorrentine paint palette of blues and whites.
findings.note: classic, antique furniture; contrast with contemporary is framing

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
